articles.title: BIG! Iran's 'Super Weapon', Putin's Deadly Upgrade Pummels Ukraine; Zelensky Aide Cries Foul | WATCH
articles.description: Ukraine’s ambassador to Israel, Yevgen Korniychuk, says Russia’s war against Ukraine and Israel’s conflict with Iran are part of the same broader struggle, with Iranian-made drones linking the two battlefields. Speaking to The Jerusalem Post ahead of Ukraine’s Independence Day, Korniychuk said Ukraine has been attacked by the same Iranian-made drones that Russia has deployed in the war. He argued that growing military cooperation between Moscow and Tehran has created a direct connection between the threats facing Ukraine and Israel. The ambassador said Ukraine and Israel are "fighting the same enemy in different corners of the same battlefield," describing what he called an emerging "axis of evil."

This policy aims to manage immigration and strengthen border security.
